query:
SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(moment_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
            COUNT(*) as count,
            COALESCE(SUM(coins_earned), 0) as coins_earned
         FROM love_moments 
         WHERE couple_id = $1
         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(moment_date, 'YYYY-MM')
         ORDER BY month DESC
         LIMIT 12
